name: watch
intendedUse: Watch view mode for the nation’s current lawful observation and visible watchlights.
modifications: Purpose-authored monochrome Night Chart mode glyph for the watch view.

redistribution.notes: Original geometry is distributed from this repository with the package source.

authoringNotes: A small watchlight throws layered arcs over water. It replaces the generic eye, which implied omniscience rather than situated lawful observation.
